placement: Before the pairwise comparison vignettes, immediately after Q0 (attention/relevance slider) and any demographic items.
rationale: Placed before the vignette task so responses reflect baseline attitudes rather than being anchored by the specific flows just seen. Correlate against pairwise win-rate and 'neither' rate post-hoc.

items.text: I am generally comfortable sharing information about my menstrual cycle with non-medical team staff, such as coaches or strength coaches.
items.scale: 5-point Likert: Strongly Disagree / Disagree / Neutral / Agree / Strongly Agree

items.text: I believe my menstrual cycle affects my athletic performance in ways that would be useful for coaches or staff to know.
items.scale: 5-point Likert: Strongly Disagree / Disagree / Neutral / Agree / Strongly Agree

items.text: I trust that information I share about my menstrual cycle would only be used for the purpose I originally agreed to.
items.scale: 5-point Likert: Strongly Disagree / Disagree / Neutral / Agree / Strongly Agree

items.text: A potential benefit to my team's performance would make me more willing to share my menstrual cycle data, even if it feels personal.
items.scale: 5-point Likert: Strongly Disagree / Disagree / Neutral / Agree / Strongly Agree

items.text: I would want to give separate, explicit permission each time my menstrual cycle data is shared with someone new, rather than agreeing to one blanket policy.
items.scale: 5-point Likert: Strongly Disagree / Disagree / Neutral / Agree / Strongly Agree
